d:
The Pelicans defeated the Grizzlies, 135-134 tonight in Memphis. Zion Williamson contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 11 rebounds and 4 assists, with Karlo Matković of the Pelicans adding an additional 25 points (9-13 FG, 5-8 3P). Ty Jerome finished with a team-high 40 points along with 5 rebounds for the Grizzlies in the losing effort. The Pelicans improve their record to 3-4 with the win, while the Grizzlies fall to 6-1 for the season.
